title: Book 1 — Clio, Chapter 82
paragraphs: Such was the condition of things at Sparta when the herald from Sardis arrived asking them to come to the assistance of Croesus, who was being besieged. And despite their own difficulties, as soon as they heard the news from the herald, they were eager to go to his aid. But when they had completed their preparations and their ships were ready, there came another message reporting that the fortress of the Lydians had been taken and that Croesus had been made a prisoner. Then, and not before, they ceased their efforts, being grieved at the event as at a great calamity.
